LBL_intro: Define every producer, consumer and storage device you want to track. Each entity points to an existing ioBroker state that reports its current power (in Watt or kW). An aggregate measurement (e.g. a Shelly 3EM) can be entered as its own entity; individually metered devices on the same circuit can reference it via "Parent (aggregate) ID" - EnergyFlow then reports "rest power" = aggregate minus the sum of its children.
LBL_historySourceIntro: Select the history instance (history, influxdb or sql adapter) that logs the power states of your entities. EnergyFlow reads hourly averages from it for the ML forecast correction (shading, soiling and inverter quirks the physics model cannot know about), the household load profile of the energy plan and the today/yesterday/7-day energy totals. Every entity power state used for this must have logging enabled in that instance. Leave empty to run without history: physics-only forecast, no load profile, no energy totals.
TTIP_historyInstance: e.g. influxdb.0, history.0 or sql.0 - the instance that logs your power states
LBL_historyIntro: How many days back the timeline scrubber in the widget and the 3D scene can scroll to show actual instead of forecast values (including the widget's forecast-vs-actual yield curve comparison). Higher values mean more Open-Meteo/history requests on every hourly forecast refresh.
TTIP_forecastHistoryDays: 0 disables the look-back - the timeline scrubber can then only scroll forward into the forecast
TTIP_colorForecast: Color of the forecast curve in the widget and the 3D scene
TTIP_colorActual: Color of the actual-value curve (real yield) in the widget and the 3D scene
LBL_pricesHeader: Prices (for the energy plan and consumption recommendations)
LBL_pricesIntro: Grid purchase price and feed-in tariff in ct/kWh. With Tibber, the dynamic quarter-hourly prices including the forecast are read from the tibberlink adapter; without Tibber, the fields point at states holding a fixed price (left empty, EnergyFlow creates its own manually-editable starter value under 0_userdata.0). The feed-in tariff stays a fixed value in both cases - with Tibber it is automatically set to 0 during negative spot prices (§51 EEG).
TTIP_oidGridPurchasePrice: State that reports the current grid purchase price in ct/kWh. Leave empty to auto-create your own manually-editable starter value under 0_userdata.0.
TTIP_oidFeedInTariff: State that reports the current feed-in tariff in ct/kWh. Leave empty to auto-create your own manually-editable starter value under 0_userdata.0.
TTIP_item_entityId: Technical, unique identifier (letters, digits, "_" and "-" only), used to build the object ID under entities.<id>.*
TTIP_item_category: What kind of entity this is
TTIP_item_powerStateId: ioBroker state that reports the current power of this entity
TTIP_item_powerUnit: Unit the power state reports its value in
TTIP_item_invertSign: Enable if the source state uses the opposite sign convention (e.g. reports grid feed-in as negative when positive is expected)
TTIP_item_noiseThresholdW: Readings whose magnitude is below this value are treated as exactly 0 instead of their raw value - for compensating a source that never quite settles at zero (sensor noise, or a stuck/stale reading that would otherwise show up as a phantom flow in the diagram even though nothing is really flowing). 0 disables the threshold.
TTIP_item_energyStateId: Optional: cumulative energy counter in kWh for this entity
TTIP_item_parentId: Optional: entity ID of an aggregate/collective measurement (e.g. a Shelly 3EM) this entity's reading is already included in. Leave empty if this entity is not part of any aggregate.
TTIP_item_invertInParent: Enable if the parent's own reading already nets this entity out instead of including it as a sub-total - e.g. a producer (such as a balcony power plant) feeding into the house wiring downstream of a house consumption meter. The rest-power calculation then adds this entity's reading back instead of subtracting it.
TTIP_item_socStateId: Optional: ioBroker state reporting the state of charge in %
TTIP_item_capacityKWh: Optional: nominal usable capacity of this storage in kWh
TTIP_item_chargeEfficiencyPercent: Optional: estimated charging efficiency in %. 100 (default) models no loss. Generates its own, separately historized loss entity - a physically motivated estimate, not a measurement.
TTIP_item_dischargeEfficiencyPercent: Optional: estimated discharging efficiency in %. 100 (default) models no loss. Kept separate from charge efficiency since charging and discharging losses can differ. Generates its own, separately historized loss entity.
TTIP_item_peakPowerKWp: Optional: nominal peak power of this producer in kWp. Set this together with tilt and azimuth to enable the Open-Meteo yield forecast for this entity.
TTIP_item_tiltDeg: Panel tilt in degrees: 0 = horizontal, 90 = vertical
TTIP_item_azimuthDeg: Panel azimuth in degrees, Open-Meteo convention: 0 = south, -90 = east, 90 = west, ±180 = north
TTIP_item_acLimitW: Optional: inverter/AC feed-in cap in Watt, if lower than the panels' own peak power (e.g. a balcony power plant whose inverter limits feed-in below the panels' rated output). The forecast is clamped to this value.
TTIP_item_efficiencyPercent: Optional: estimated DC/AC efficiency of this producer in %, e.g. the inverter datasheet's "Euro efficiency". 100 (default) models no loss. Generates its own, separately historized loss entity - a physically motivated estimate, not a measurement.
TTIP_item_color: Display color for this entity in flow-diagram widgets
TTIP_useTibber: Reads the current purchase price and the price forecast (today/tomorrow) from the tibberlink adapter instead of a fixed price state.
TTIP_tibberInstance: The tibberlink instance whose prices are read.
TTIP_tibberHomeId: The home whose prices are read. The list is read live from the selected tibberlink instance (the EnergyFlow instance must be running for that); the home id is stored, not the address.
LBL_flexLoadIntro: For a typical shiftable consumer (e.g. washing machine, dishwasher) the energy plan finds the cheapest start window - valued at the marginal cost of each additional kWh (PV surplus, battery, grid price).
TTIP_flexLoadDurationH: Typical run time of the flexible consumer in hours.
TTIP_flexLoadPowerKW: Average power draw of the flexible consumer in kW.
TTIP_item_minSocPercent: Lowest state of charge the energy plan may discharge to (e.g. the inverter's shutdown SoC). Default 20.
TTIP_item_maxSocPercent: Highest state of charge for the energy plan. Default 100.
LBL_item_maxPowerKW: Max. charge/discharge power kW (plan, storage only)
TTIP_item_maxPowerKW: Maximum charge/discharge power the energy plan assumes (e.g. the inverter's AC rating). 0 = no limit.
TTIP_item_wearCostCtPerKWh: Estimated ageing cost per discharged kWh, e.g. purchase price / (capacity × depth of discharge × cycle count). Keeps the plan from recommending extra cycles over tiny price differences.
TTIP_maxGridExportW: Grid export limit enforced by the inverter (e.g. Deye register 40144). Surplus above it is curtailed – the energy plan accounts for that and may recommend “export before charging”. 0 = no limit.
TTIP_item_powerSource: Measurement: the configured state. Balance: computed from the other categories (grid = consumption − production + storage, storage = production + grid − consumption) when the source is unreliable. Measurement, balance on outage: measured, but the balance stands in while the source stops updating - e.g. for a cloud-fed meter like Tibber Pulse. Only one entity can come from the balance.
TTIP_item_staleAfterS: Seconds without a source update after which the balance stands in. Default 120.
TTIP_item_exportStateId: For meters reporting import and export as two positive values (e.g. Tibber Pulse powerConsumption / powerProduction): power = import state − export state. Leave empty if the power state is already signed.
TTIP_item_fallbackStateId: Second measured source used while the primary source is down - before the balance is used. E.g. the inverter's grid register (Deye 40626 "Grid side total power") as a stand-in for Tibber Pulse. Signed, in W (positive = import/charging).
TTIP_item_fallbackInvertSign: Flip the sign of the fallback reading if the source reports export/charging as positive.
TTIP_item_inverterAcStateId: AC output power of the hybrid inverter in W (positive = feeding the house, e.g. Deye 40637 "Inverter output total power"). Creates a MEASURED loss entity: DC inputs (PV + battery) − AC output, including the inverter's own consumption. Replaces the estimated efficiency losses of the assigned producers and of this storage.
TTIP_item_inverterPvIds: Comma-separated entity IDs of the producers on this hybrid inverter's DC side, e.g. "pv_string1,pv_string2".
